title: Exact admission-family performance readiness verification
scope: Verify additive factor-space reconciliation, exact A0-A7 offline measurement authority, deterministic no-timing campaign compilation, the additive ProtocolLab rack A0/A3/A4/A7 pilot, fail-closed negative cases, package-backed production-seam execution, immutable raw evidence, and non-accepting pilot analysis. This artifact does not claim a stable rule, performance acceptance, active behavior, production readiness, or publishable provenance.
verification_method: Canonical JSON schema and hash validation; exact catalog, proof, campaign, pilot, manifest, cell, policy-tuple, package, controller, topology, job, run, artifact, runtime-evidence, correctness, and checksum checks; focused positive and negative runtime/package authorization tests; deterministic compiler replay; ProtocolLab isolated-pair execution; Release builds; direct touched-artifact SpecTrace validation; and diff hygiene.
preconditions: The passed A0 through A7 correctness result and its current reviewed proof catalog remain present.
The selected execution host is the ProtocolLab rack with controller-owned isolated-pair placement.
The selected initial scope is A0, A3, A4, and A7 using the existing raw QUIC multiplex.100x64kb workload.
Performance acceptance, adaptive selection, active behavior, and production activation remain false.
procedure: Validate factor-cell-space v3 against the current family v5 hash and prove retained v2 is unchanged.
Verify exactly A0 through A7 are the reviewed exhaustive measurement subset and all bounded cells remain blocked.
Create an exact admission performance authorization for each A0-A7 tuple and reject mismatched hashes, cells, values, adjacent axes, or concurrent authorization tokens.
Compile the campaign twice and prove byte-identical canonical output without collecting timing observations.
Compile the additive selected-pilot manifest twice and prove byte-identical output for ProtocolLab rack, exact A0/A3/A4/A7 cells, and the existing package-backed raw QUIC workload.
Reject covering-array requests, blocked values, stale inputs, outside axes, correctness intent, performance-acceptance intent, and active intent.
Build the raw QUIC implementation package for each exact cell from clean committed source and prove the package manifest carries the exact policy tuple and authorization identity.
Submit the four cells serially through the ProtocolLab controller with isolated-pair placement, two repetitions per cell, and no explicit worker IDs.

Retain job, run, package, topology, aggregate result, runtime evidence, artifact index, and checksum identities; reject failed requests, timeouts, unsupported outcomes, wrong cells, wrong packages, shared topology, or unreadable required artifacts.
Analyze A4 minus A0, A3 minus A0, A7 minus A4, A7 minus A3, and A7 minus A0 while labeling batch and buffer as a combined effect in the four-cell pilot.
Run focused source tests and Release builds with the repository's documented analyzer floor.
Validate SPEC-QUIC-CRT-ADMISSION-PERFORMANCE, ARC-QUIC-CRT-0119, WI-QUIC-CRT-0120, and VER-QUIC-CRT-0121 directly.
Run git diff --check and confirm no covering-array generation, performance acceptance, CI change, push, or production activation occurred.
expected_result: The current factor space is reconciled additively; only the exact reviewed A0 through A7 family can receive internal offline measurement authorization; the retained dry run and selected four-cell pilot compile deterministically and fail closed; exact package-backed rack jobs run on credible isolated topology with readable immutable evidence; the pilot reports bounded comparisons without isolating batch from buffer or accepting a rule; and focused tests and builds pass or retain a precise inherited blocker.
status_summary: Local pilot implementation passed on 2026-07-28: the retained readiness path passed 21 assertions with eight reviewed cells, four blocked cells, eight timing-disabled work items, and no measurements; the additive rack pilot passed 15 assertions with deterministic manifest a56b59fdd26ce16a7131197269415e19175184c7d5f8da346d2b367218eb29cb, four planned cells, and no measurements; the focused admission/package slice passed 44 of 44 tests; and both the raw QUIC server and adapter Release builds passed without warnings or errors. Direct schema validation passed for this specification, ARC-QUIC-CRT-0119, WI-QUIC-CRT-0120, and this verification artifact. The broad test project completed with 10,247 passed, 4 skipped, and 7 unrelated failures in Windows path budget, retained gate-field inventory, completion-source reflection ambiguity, sent-packet layout, and two HTTP/3 sent-packet-index cases. The repository-wide SpecTrace validator retains 2,693 inherited migration and unresolved-reference errors, while all four touched canonical artifacts pass direct schema validation. The clean-source execute attempt from commits 3c4b1465 and ca733b85 compiled the exact pilot manifest at C:\shared\temp\quic-dotnet\admission-performance-pilot-20260728-1310\compiled-manifest.json, then stopped before package creation or job submission because http://10.10.99.176:5088/api/lab/nodes timed out after 15 seconds. Actual measurements remain zero; performance acceptance and activation remain false.
